facts.fact: Max 开车回到 Fairhope，停在镇口空路上——她发誓永不再回的地方。
facts.anchor: parked on the empty road leading into Fairhope—the one place I swore I’d never return to.

facts.fact: 回乡的真正原因：自从收到同学会请柬起她就陷入严重写作障碍，八个多小时车程是来破除诅咒。
facts.anchor: comes down to two words no writer ever wants to say out loud—writer’s block.

facts.fact: Crashing Echoes 上市不到一个月已横扫所有畅销榜，新书压力大到她怕再也写不出来。
facts.anchor: It’s been on the market for less than a month, and I’ve already hit every bestseller list there is.

facts.fact: Max 正要掉头回纽约时 Cathie 打来 FaceTime，把她劝住。
facts.anchor: There’s only one person on earth who ignores my no-FaceTime rule, and that’s Cathie.

facts.fact: Cathie 发来 Scarlett Price 全专辑歌单给她壮胆。
facts.anchor: a playlist with the entire discography of Scarlett Price

facts.fact: Max 没说出口的是：这次同学会不只是毕业班聚会，而是全镇活动，要办整整一周。
facts.anchor: It’s an event for the whole town.

facts.fact: 本想去 Alder House 民宿，结果车停在 Maple Road 老家门前——马路对面就是 Milo Fletcher 家。
facts.anchor: I’m parked on Maple Road—the same place I called home until I left at nineteen.

facts.fact: 结尾闪回：某个万圣节夜，Milo 和 Max 一起埋葬了各自的母亲——两家从此再不过万圣节。
facts.anchor: Because that was the day Milo and I buried our mothers.
